name: rpn_refactor_reduce
task: sum_all() and product_all() in main.cpp duplicate the same loop-over-a-vector structure, differing only in the accumulation operator and the identity value the accumulator starts from. Refactor them to eliminate this duplication (e.g. via a shared private helper taking a binary operation and identity value, or by using std::accumulate directly). Keep both public function signatures and their behavior unchanged.
